market_definition: The polyimide high-temperature adhesives market comprises adhesives based on polyimide resins and precursors that retain strength above 250 °C. It measures sales of liquid, film and paste adhesives for aerospace, electronics and thermal-extreme bonding. BY FORM: Liquid / Varnish, Film, Paste. BY POLYMER TYPE: Thermoset Polyimide, Thermoplastic Polyimide, Polyamide-Imide / Bismaleimide. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Aerospace & Defense, Flexible Electronics & Circuits, Semiconductor Packaging, Automotive Powertrain, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Polyimide foam; polyimide films, resins or fibres sold for non-adhesive use; silicone and epoxy high-temperature adhesives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
